retail_vs_institutional_positioning.retail_positioning_summary: Retail crypto and equity traders across Reddit (r/wallstreetbets, r/cryptocurrency) and X FinTwit view Coinbase as the premier regulated gatekeeper to the digital asset economy. Retail sentiment is +76% bullish heading into the Oct 29 print, energized by Bitcoin consolidation near all-time highs and optimism regarding the post-election regulatory landscape. Retail options traders actively buy weekly $170 and $180 strike call options, expecting a post-earnings volatility spike. However, retail participants remain wary of COIN's historical tendency to sell off after reporting mark-to-market crypto investment revaluation losses.
retail_vs_institutional_positioning.institutional_positioning_summary: Institutional sell-side sentiment is constructive: 33 analysts covering COIN maintain a consensus Buy rating (1.97 mean) with a $213.55 mean price target (+33.95% upside) and Street highs reaching $330.00. Institutional desks view Coinbase as an indispensable infrastructure provider after securing custody for the vast majority of spot crypto ETFs. Hedge funds maintain tactical long positions paired with options collar hedges, taking note of elevated short interest (11.08% of float) which creates potential squeeze fuel on any top-line surprise. With Put/Call OI at 0.50x, options flows reflect strong call demand into the ±8.89% ($14.18) weekly straddle pricing.
